title: osEngineer dispatch payload
description: client_payload of a GitHub repository_dispatch that starts a headless osEngineer run. GitHub caps client_payload at 10 top-level keys, so this envelope stays small deliberately. Every value is untrusted input: it originates outside the repo and must never be interpolated into a workflow run: body or a shell command.

verb.description: osEngineer command verb to run, without the osEngineer: prefix.

args.description: Arguments appended to the rendered prompt as text. Never shell-evaluated.

correlation_id.description: Idempotency key. Echoed into the Jira comment marker so a retried run does not comment twice.

issue_key.description: Jira issue this run reports back to.
